'''Spar''' is a [[Darkfriend]] working for [[Old Cully]].

== Appearance ==
He is rat-faced, has sunken cheeks and arms that are all sinew and bone.

== Activities ==
He is sent by Old Cully to kill [[Matrim Cauthon]]. He dresses up as beggars with the rest of his men and ambush Mat and his men. Mat kills Spar before real beggars attack the rest of Spars group.
